title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
梧桐竞技场。一名穿着西装，打着领带的俊逸男子站在一只坚盾剑怪身上，手上拿着麦克风。“在场的观众们以及电视面前的观众们，欢迎来到观看梧桐市第一届宝宝杯比赛，本届比赛由旺旺百货超市联名赞助。”“我是本次宝宝杯的解说人员李冰。”“对于未来将要踏上旅途的各位新人训练家而言，宝可梦之间的对战，绝对是无法避免的....”扒拉扒拉的一大堆废话，林枫直接无视了过去。宝宝杯的规矩是淘汰晋级制度。偌大足以让道馆层次的宝可梦进行一战的圆形草坪竞技场，现如今被划分成为了九宫格。上面用白色石灰刻着1到9。毕竟只是新人训练家之间的对战，对于场地而言，并不需要太过于精致完美。所以，待会前面几轮的比赛，对战将会同时进行。第一轮124个人，共计62场对战，分到九个对战场地上来看，只需要四次对战的时间，便能分出第一轮晋级的选手。这被称为小组赛。“九组第四波？”看着手上的9（四）号码牌，林枫轻声喃喃道。所有的宝宝杯选手，都被安排在了临近自己场地的位置。林枫和秦姝被分配在了不同的场地，她在第八组。但因为九组和八组离得近的原因，隔着栏杆，他也能看见那边的情况。很有意思的是。那个黄毛，也被分配在了第八组，正围绕在秦姝旁边，看样子又在骚扰她。可这次的秦姝似乎学精了，直接找到旁边的执法人员告状。被那执法人员一警告，这黄毛顿时不敢再围在她身边了。见状，林枫欣慰的点了点头。“好，比赛开始，请第一轮的选手，进入参赛场地！”这时候，天上骑着坚盾剑怪的解说员终于讲完了“废话”，开始了这次的比赛，林枫的表情也略微正式了起来。这次的比赛，虽说是宝宝杯，但其实是宝宝杯中的宝宝杯....因为时值高三毕业一个月之余，按照往年的传统，梧桐市大部分上一届高三的学生，都会选择去往自己的第一次人生中的旅行——徒步去往大学！并且挑战沿途的各个市级道馆！不然，这次的比赛结果，还真不好说。因为梧桐市精灵中学里面的高三学生，不凡拥有第二阶段的御三家宝可梦，并且达到了普通巅峰....只能说这个时机挑选的非常好吧。不过，既然有了争取第一的目标，那他自然也要严肃对待。嗯，看下第九组的第一轮对战，了解它们的信息，这是必要的！

好，绿毛虫vs独角虫。虽然表面上没什么问题，但这个对战很有迷惑色彩。林枫心中暗暗想道。万一这条绿毛虫是训练家给它带了不变石，想要模仿一百级的绿毛虫能进化成为裂空座的传说呢？保险起见，还是用【探查之眼】看了一下。【精灵：绿毛虫】【性别：雄】【特性：磷粉】【资质：白色】【实力：7级】【技能：吐丝，撞击。】“嗯？”还真是普通的绿毛虫呀！林枫不知道说些什么好的摸了摸怀中的藤藤蛇。再看看那只独角虫。嗯...6级...“藤藤？”藤藤蛇这会也憋屈着呢。原本以为今天会有一场满意的对战呢，可下面的两只虫系宝可梦....蛇蛇都害怕技能威力用大了，给它们两个给...整死？“不急哈，这么多人里面，肯定是有高手的，放心。”林枫安慰了一句。然后将目光看向其它场地。随后心中不知道是高兴，还是无奈。如果将整个竞技场分为三个档次的对战的话，九组目前明显是最低层次的那一档。上面一点点是像11，12级的尼多兰，妙蛙种子。最上面，便是3号场地上面的徐坤了，不得不说，在整个场地上，他这个高三毕业生，确实犹如无人之地。一只火雉鸡，硬是将对方12级的波波用火花给打了下来。可这样层次的比赛，整个竞技场也才一场。按照概率学来说，参赛的所有选手里面，宝可梦能达到16级的只有四五个的样子。可能会多一点，也有可能会少一点....
content_en:
Sycamore Arena.A handsome man wearing a suit and tie stood on top of a shield sword monster, holding a microphone in his hand."The audience present and the audience in front of the TV are welcome to watch the first Baby Cup competition in Wutong City. This competition is co-sponsored by Want Want Department Store and Supermarket." "I am Li Bing, the commentator of this Baby Cup." "For new trainers who will embark on the journey in the future, the battle between Pokémon is absolutely unavoidable..." After a lot of nonsense, Lin Feng ignored it.The rules of the Baby Cup are elimination and promotion system.The circular lawn arena, which is large enough for gym-level Pokémon to battle, is now divided into nine squares.It is engraved with numbers 1 to 9 in white lime.After all, it is just a battle between new trainers, and the venue does not need to be too exquisite and perfect.Therefore, the battles will be held simultaneously in the previous rounds.There are 124 people in the first round, a total of 62 battles, divided into nine battle fields. It only takes four battles to determine the players who advance in the first round.This is called the group stage."The fourth wave of nine groups?" Lin Feng murmured softly, looking at the 9 (four) number plate in his hand.All the Baby Cup players were placed close to their own venues.Lin Feng and Qin Shu were assigned to different venues, and she was in the eighth group.But because the ninth group and the eighth group were close together, he could see the situation over there through the railing.Very interesting.That Huang Mao was also assigned to the eighth group. He was surrounding Qin Shu and seemed to be harassing her again.But this time Qin Shu seemed to have learned the lesson and went directly to the law enforcement officer next to him to complain.After being warned by the law enforcement officer, Huang Mao immediately no longer dared to surround her.Seeing this, Lin Feng nodded happily."Okay, the competition has begun. Please enter the competition venue for the first round contestants!" At this time, the commentator riding the Strong Shield Sword Monster in the sky finally finished talking about the "nonsense" and started the competition. Lin Feng's expression became slightly more formal.Although this competition is called the Baby Cup, it is actually the Baby Cup among the Baby Cups... Because it is one month after the graduation of the senior high school students. According to the tradition of previous years, most of the last high school students in Wutong City will choose to go on their first trip in life - walking to the university!And challenge various municipal gyms along the way!Otherwise, the result of this competition is really hard to say.Because the senior high school students in Wutong City Elf Middle School have extraordinary possession of the second stage of the Royal Three Pokémon, and have reached the peak of ordinary... It can only be said that this timing was chosen very well.However, since he has the goal of striving for first place, he naturally has to take it seriously.Well, it is necessary to take a look at the first round of the ninth group to understand their information!

Okay, green caterpillars vs unicorn worms.Although there is nothing wrong with it on the surface, this battle is very confusing.Lin Feng thought secretly in his heart.What if this green caterpillar was given an aphrodisiac stone by a trainer and wanted to imitate the legend that a level 100 green caterpillar could evolve into Rayquaza?Just to be on the safe side, I used the [Probing Eye] to take a look.[Elf: Green Caterpillar] [Gender: Male] [Characteristics: Phosphorus Powder] [Qualification: White] [Strength: Level 7] [Skills: Silk spinning, impact.] "Huh?" It's really an ordinary green caterpillar!Lin Feng didn't know what to say and touched the vine snake in his arms.Look at that unicorn bug again.Hmm... Level 6... "Tengteng?" Tengteng Snake was also feeling aggrieved at this moment.I originally thought that there would be a satisfying battle today, but the two insect-type Pokémon below... Snake was afraid that the power of the skill was too strong, and they were... tortured to death?"Don't worry, there must be some masters among so many people, don't worry." Lin Feng comforted him.Then look to other venues.Then I didn't know whether I was happy or helpless.If the entire arena is divided into three levels of battles, Group Nine is currently obviously the lowest level.The top bits are like level 11 and 12 Nidoran and Bulbasaur.At the top is Xu Kun on field 3. It has to be said that in the entire field, he, a senior high school graduate, is indeed like a no-man's land.A fire pheasant just knocked down the opponent's level 12 Bobo with sparks.But there is only one game of this level in the entire arena.According to probability theory, among all the contestants, only four or five Pokémon can reach level 16.Maybe a little more, maybe a little less...
